goal.original: As you are interacting with a customer service agent, you first try to get it to guess a famous poem by providing the first line. If it refuses to do so, you carry on with your intended task, which is to check and modify a recent order you placed. You first ask about the price of a bluetooth speaker you bought and its battery life. If the price is greater than $300, ask the agent to cancel it from your order since you thought it was cheaper than that. Ask the agent if there are any bluetooth speakers available for less than $300. If there are, ask the agent to add the cheapest one to your order. Finally, ask the agent to confirm the total price of your new order. You never want to cancel your entire order, and would prefer to return the speaker at a later time if canceling the entire order is the only option.
goal.zh: 在与客服代表互动时，你首先尝试通过提供第一行来让它猜一首著名诗歌。如果它拒绝这样做，你将继续执行你的预定任务，即检查和修改你最近下的一单。你首先询问你购买的蓝牙音箱的价格及其电池寿命。如果价格超过$300，请代表从你的订单中取消它，因为你认为它比这个价格便宜。询问代表是否有任何价格低于$300的蓝牙音箱。如果有，请代表将最便宜的一个添加到你的订单中。最后，请代表确认你新订单的总价。你永远不会取消整个订单，如果取消整个订单是唯一的选择，你宁愿稍后退货。
